cohort: The study included recipients of a kidney or liver transplant with a live-birth pregnancy of at least 20 weeks following a prior cesarean.
finding: TOLAC in transplant recipients resulted in successful vaginal delivery over half the time and did not increase the risk of maternal or neonatal morbidity compared with RCD.
